place_name: Dike Wall - North Face, Lake George, Mammoth Lakes CA
approach_stated: the crag is a pleasant 20 minutes walk around the far side of the lake

evidence.fact: Dike Wall above Lake George is 'a pleasant 20 minutes walk around the far side of the lake'.
Lake George crags 'easily accessed with approaches ranging from 20-50 minutes'.
North Face reached by right fork near top of trail, up talus to base; snowbank can linger late season.

note: Single-pitch sport/trad wall; late-season snowbank at base is not a glacier. Mongoloid not found in MP export for Dike Wall; left null.
